_comment: The screenshots the help system shows, in the order they appear in the Word
guide. The Word document is the SOURCE: the pictures are pasted in there
once, against the numbered placeholders, and build-help.js lifts them out.
Order is the only link between the two. Word stores a picture as a
relationship id pointing at word/media/imageN, and those ids are allocated
in document order, so the Nth picture in the document is the Nth slot here.
Nothing else in a .docx says which caption a picture belongs to.
'after' is the element in tool-guide.html the figure is inserted after,
given as the id of its section plus which heading inside it.

figures.caption: The main window — sidebar, request form and response, with an endpoint open.
Settings ▸ Servers. Each profile carries its own address and app identity.
Signing in, with Remember this password ticked.
A production profile: red header, banner, and a confirmation before every write.
The idle countdown. Any movement or keypress cancels it.
A POST being composed, with the body template beside the field reference.
Capturing a value out of a response into a variable.
The Variables panel, with a captured value among them.
The import pane: a type chosen, headers fetched, and the drop zone ready.
The Data tab. Tables and views are listed apart, and a view says so.
Filtering the schema by column name to find which tables carry it.
Completion in context: past FROM, columns are offered ahead of keywords.
After an alias and a dot, only that table's columns are offered.
A result table, with statuses and booleans coloured by meaning.
Comparing a query against the last time it ran.
The access-right chip on an endpoint whose description names one.
Reviewing what a catalog update would change, item by item.
